fields.label: Examination Mode
fields.description: Leave blank to follow the college's Examination Mode (Institution Profile). Affiliated: the university runs the end-semester examinations of this regulation's students.

fields.label: Carry Forward CIA
fields.description: An arrear attempt keeps the CIA marks of the first attempt.

fields.label: Absence Counts as an Attempt
fields.description: A withdrawal or a shortage of attendance never counts as an attempt.

fields.label: Maximum Attempts
fields.description: 0: no limit other than the programme duration.

fields.label: Internal Only Pass %
fields.description: Pass mark, as % of the CIA maximum, of an Internal Only course.

fields.label: Third Valuation Above %
fields.description: A third valuation is allocated when the first two differ by more than this % of the ESE maximum.

fields.label: Final ESE Mark
fields.options:
Average of Closest Two
Average of Third and Nearer
fields.description: With two valuations their average; with three, this rule. Rounded half up to a whole mark.

fields.label: Allow Course Teacher as Examiner
fields.description: When off, a teacher of the course in the session's term cannot value its scripts.

fields.label: Grace Marks Allowed
fields.description: The Result Run adds the fewest whole ESE marks that make a failed course pass, within the limits below. Every grace is listed in the Grace Mark Audit report.

fields.label: Maximum Courses with Grace
fields.description: Per student per session. 0: no limit.

fields.label: Maximum Total Grace
fields.description: Per student per session. 0: no limit.

fields.label: Application Window (days)
fields.description: Photocopy, revaluation and review applications are accepted from the release of the results until this many days after it. 0: none accepted.

fields.label: Revaluation after Photocopy and Justification
fields.description: A revaluation needs the issued photocopy of the script and a justification by a teacher of the course (R2022 16.4). Which course types are eligible is set per type above.
